doc: boundaryPoint, routeBetween, routeOf, setRoute, bindEnd, refitArrow and detach. Scenes are plain lists of elements (built by the builders under ids src-0001...; the call's own ids are id-0001...) and are looked up by id. bindEnd/refitArrow/detach record `returns` (changed elements as ids; detach: [ids to remove, ids changed]) and `after.elements`, the whole scene as the call left it. `byId: false` on bindEnd passes no lookup.
